scoring_justification: Cannot recompute metrics from raw band structure files (not submitted); the checker compares submitted aggregated tables against paper‑reported values with tolerances and enforces required structural trends (periodicity, monotonicity, hump, ordering).

outputs.description: Edge band gap (EG) and non‑edge band gap (NEG) as a function of bending curvature for A13MoS2. Rows must cover the full set of curvatures from flat to high bending.

schema.description: Three lines, each containing a label (e.g., kappa0:, kappac1:, kappac2:) followed by a floating‑point value in 1/Å.

outputs.description: The three critical bending curvatures κ0, κc1, κc2 derived from the EG/NEG curves.
Edge gap and non‑degenerate edge‑band splits for flat armchair MoS2 nanoribbons as a function of ribbon width n (n = 9…24).
Quasiparticle and exciton properties for A13MoS2 at four bending radii (R = ∞, 13, 9, 6 Å) as defined in the paper’s Table 1.

output_contract.notes: All files are plain text (CSV or TXT). Numeric values should be reported with sufficient precision for comparison. No gold values or tolerances are given here; they are part of the hidden grading specification.

steps.description: Validate curvature‑gap CSV: existence of flat and high curvature points, approximate EG/NEG values, EG decrease, NEG hump at κc1.

hidden_assets.generation_method: visual extraction of band‑gap values at several curvatures (flat, κc1, high‑curvature).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are rough but enough to check correct trends and plausible magnitudes, not a precise table.
